steps.title: Goal
body: Crack a secret 4-color code.
You get up to 7 guesses; match the code exactly to win.
Use all 7 without matching and you lose — retry anytime.

steps.title: Three modes
body: Easy: per-column green / white / off — great for learning.
Advanced: only totals of greens and whites, no column marks.
Challenge: more colors, repeats allowed, countdown — timeout loses like running out of guesses.
Campaign progress is saved separately per mode.

steps.title: Timers
body: Easy / Advanced: count up from 00:00; results show time and local bests.
Challenge: countdown; help open or a hidden tab pauses the clock.
Challenge bests use elapsed time (limit minus remaining) — shorter is better.
The last ~10 seconds show a light cue (mute sound; reduced motion softens animation).

steps.title: Controls
body: Tap a cell to select; tap again to cycle colors.
Bottom palette fills the current slot in one tap.
Knob: drag to cycle · short press to move · long press to submit; or use Submit.

steps.title: Green & white
body: Green: right color in the right place.
White: color is in the code, wrong place.
Off: that color is not in the code.

steps.title: Campaign & practice
body: Solo campaign: clear levels to unlock the next; progress stays on this device.
Free Practice: tune intensity, colors, repeats, hints, timer; or reuse Easy / Advanced / Challenge.
Turn on “Preset secret” so a friend sets the code, you hand over the device, then you crack it (local duo).
Under Help & Settings you can open the tutorial and change language, theme, and sound; top-right ? opens help.
